vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Cameron, Wyatt, Ritwik, Nadia and Valeria met them at the door — 5 put down. Cameron, Wyatt, Ritwik, Nadia, Valeria are hurt.
🛡️ Cameron, Nadia, Tashi and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down. Cameron, Nadia, Tashi, Victor are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Cameron — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Cameron chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Cameron, Aria and Tashi met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Cameron, Aria are hurt.
